ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between primary low-intensity (black/dark grey) base pigmentation and localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation dominates the central and lower lobes. High-intensity white pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips (lateral extremes) and along the inner trailing edge. Small high-intensity white focal points (speckling) are distributed across the mid-ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 35 degrees with a significant vertical-to-horizontal depth ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5-15 pixels. Serrations are more pronounced and jagged in the mid-section of the trailing edge between the notch and the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upwardly swept, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white pixels (sessile barnacles) located at the extreme left and right tips, forming contiguous masses.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across both lobes; three prominent diagonal marks on the left lobe and several shorter vertical marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; numerous white rake marks (scars) distributed across the ventral fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense barnacle 'capping' on the outer tips and a distinctive white linear mark on the lower right quadrant near the fluke base.
